usage.text:
The pendulum swings down under gravity and strikes the initially stationary ball at 0.43 s. The ball briefly lifts off the floor, lands again at 0.47 s, and rolls toward the cup.

It climbs the cup’s entry ramp, crosses the low lip, and reaches the cup base at 1.72 s. After contacting the far wall at 2.31 s, it slows and remains inside the cup through the end of the run. The cup’s centre is exactly 1 m from the ball’s starting position.
